title: Check names each undocumented export's file from one lookup, so its time grows linearly
description: check names each undocumented export's file from one lookup, so its time grows linearly
no_spec_change_rationale: SPEED-1.b: check stays proportional to the specs it touches; naming each undocumented export's file rescanned every export, so check time grew with the square of their number (#574). Output is unchanged
